empty_space.where: The lower-right quadrant of the poster contains a large blank region, reducing the efficient use of the canvas.

overflow.where: No text or visuals are clipped or overlapping.

small_visual_text.where: The axes labels and legends in Figures 2 and 3 are too small to read clearly at a viewing distance of 1–2 m.

dense_text.where: Text blocks are generally manageable and not overly dense.

caption_mismatch.where: Captions correspond correctly to their respective visuals.

unclear_order.where: The reading order is logical, following a left-to-right and top-to-bottom flow.

main_result_hidden.where: The main results are visible in Figures 2 and 3, which are prominently displayed in the Evaluation section.

layout.reason: The layout is logical and sections are well-separated, but the large blank region in the lower-right quadrant reduces the efficient use of the canvas.

readability.reason: Text is generally readable, but figure axes labels and legends are too small to be legible at a typical viewing distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster emphasizes the main findings of the paper and includes relevant figures and captions, but the small visual text slightly detracts from the clarity of the results.

holistic.reason: The poster communicates the main message effectively, but the large blank region and small visual text reduce its overall clarity and accessibility.
